topic: 12.12 sale: Rs 2 lakh ad spend, 400 messages in one hour (kitchen/home)
lines: Do lakh rupay ke ads lagaye, ab chaar sau messages kaun sambhalega?
Do log, ek phone, aur ek ghante mein chaar sau messages.
Jab tak pehle ko reply karoge, baaqi customers tab band kar denge.
Sale mein jawab ki raftaar paisa banati hai.
A I sabko ek saath jawab deta hai: price, stock, order link.
Aapki team sirf packing aur dispatch sambhale.
Yeh reel kisi seller ko bhejein.
Sale ke liye bot chahiye? Comment SALE.
